02.title: 建立你的第一場活動
02.next_title: 報名組別、年齡規則與隊名

narration.v1: 建立一場活動非常簡單。從主辦後台左側選『所有活動』，再點右上角的『建立活動』按鈕，建立流程立刻啟動。RegMaster 的設計理念是：先把活動骨架建好，再慢慢補資料。每一步系統都會自動存檔，不怕中途離開，回來繼續編輯也不會掉資料。
narration.v2: 在彈出視窗，先填活動名稱，例如『RegMaster 示範春季賽』。選擇活動類別，這裡選競賽。再選活動形式為個人報名。下方的容量上限可以先留空，之後再到設定頁細調。確認資料後按下『建立』，系統會立刻產生活動，並把你帶到詳細設定頁，整個流程不到十秒。
narration.v3: 詳細設定頁的『基本資訊』，活動名稱已自動帶入。下方的活動描述支援基本 HTML，會直接顯示在公開頁的『關於這場活動』，方便報名者了解活動主題與規則。建議寫清楚活動緣起、報名對象、聯絡資訊，能大幅減少報名者來信詢問，省下大量客服時間。
narration.v4: 接著設定關鍵時間：開放報名時間是活動可以被報名的起點；報名截止時間到了會自動關閉新報名；活動日則是實際舉行的日期。RegMaster 會根據時間自動切換活動狀態，從草稿到開放，再到截止，全程不必手動切換按鈕，省心又安全。
narration.v5: 最後右下角按下『儲存變更』，所有設定立刻生效。回到『所有活動』清單，剛建立的活動已顯示在列表上，狀態是草稿，隨時可以繼續編輯。骨架完成後，下一步就是設定組別與規則，繼續往下走。

02.outro: 本部影片到這裡。直接點下方按鈕,看下一部:『報名組別、年齡規則與隊名』。或進入 regmaster-pro.web.app 看完整教學系列。

narration_en.v1: Creating an event is simple. In the organizer dashboard, choose 'All Events' on the left, then click the 'Create Event' button in the top-right, and the process begins instantly. RegMaster's philosophy is to build the skeleton of your event first, then fill in the details bit by bit. Every step saves automatically, so you can leave partway through and pick up right where you left off without losing anything.
narration_en.v2: In the pop-up window, start with the event name, for example 'RegMaster Spring Showcase.' Choose the event type, here we'll pick 'Competition.' Then set the registration format to 'Individual.' You can leave the capacity limit blank for now and fine-tune it later in settings. Confirm the details and click 'Create,' and the system creates the event right away and takes you to the detailed settings page, all in under ten seconds.
narration_en.v3: On the detailed settings page, under 'Basic Information,' the event name is already filled in. The description field below supports basic HTML and appears directly in the 'About this event' section of your public page, helping registrants understand the theme and rules. We recommend clearly describing the event's background, who it's for, and contact details. It greatly reduces inquiry emails and saves you a lot of support time.
narration_en.v4: Next, set the key dates: the registration open date is when people can start signing up; when the registration deadline arrives, new registrations close automatically; and the event date is when it actually takes place. RegMaster switches the event status automatically based on these times, from draft to open to closed, with no manual buttons to toggle. It's effortless and reliable.
narration_en.v5: Finally, click 'Save Changes' in the bottom-right, and all your settings take effect immediately. Back in the 'All Events' list, the event you just created appears with a 'Draft' status, ready to keep editing anytime. With the skeleton in place, the next step is setting up divisions and rules. Let's keep going.

03.title: 報名組別、年齡規則與隊名
03.next_title: 表單設計器：自訂報名欄位

narration.v1: 歡迎回到 RegMaster 教學。本部影片我們聚焦在『報名組別』。組別是活動結構的骨架，設計得好，後面整套金流、評分、證書都能順著跑。活動建立完成後，下一步是設定報名組別。在『設定』的『組別』分頁，你可以區隔不同年齡層、能力等級或主題的選手分組。系統內建了常見組別預設，例如國小、國中、高中、社會組，可以直接選用，省去逐一輸入的時間。組別越清楚，後續評分、排名、發證書就越順。
narration.v2: 點選『新增組別』，輸入組別名稱，例如『公開組』。每個組別都可以單獨設定年齡規則：選擇『不限年齡』、依『年齡區間』、或依『出生日期區間』。設好之後，系統會在報名時自動驗證選手的生日。這對於常見的『未滿幾歲不得報名』或『跨組混報』糾紛特別有用。
narration.v3: 下方的『隊伍命名』區塊，讓你決定報名時是否要求填寫隊伍名稱。可以分別開啟『要求中文隊名』顯示為公開頁的隊伍識別，或『要求英文隊名』用於國際性活動或證書印製。團體賽通常兩者都打開，個人賽則可以全部關閉。組別與隊名設定好之後，下一步是調整報名表單。組別與隊名設定完成，活動的人員分層就架好了。下一部我們會繼續往表單設計器走，把每位選手要填的欄位也客製化。

03.outro: 本部影片到這裡。直接點下方按鈕,看下一部:『表單設計器:自訂報名欄位』。或進入 regmaster-pro.web.app 看完整教學系列。

narration_en.v1: Welcome back to the RegMaster tutorials. This episode focuses on registration divisions. Divisions are the backbone of your event's structure; design them well, and payments, scoring, and certificates all flow smoothly afterward. Once your event is created, the next step is setting up divisions. In the 'Divisions' tab under 'Settings,' you can separate participants by age group, skill level, or theme. The system comes with common presets, like Elementary, Junior High, High School, and Open, that you can select directly, saving you from typing each one. The clearer your divisions, the smoother scoring, ranking, and certificates will be.
narration_en.v2: Click 'Add Division' and enter a name, such as 'Open Division.' Each division can have its own age rule: choose no age limit, an age range, or a date-of-birth range. Once set, the system automatically validates each participant's birth date at registration. This is especially useful for the common 'must be over a certain age' requirement, or for preventing disputes over cross-division entries.
narration_en.v3: In the 'Team Naming' section below, you decide whether a team name is required at registration. You can separately enable a required Chinese team name, shown as the team's public identifier, or a required English team name, used for international events or certificate printing. Team competitions usually turn on both, while individual events can leave them off. With divisions and team names in place, your event's participant structure is set. In the next episode, we'll move on to the form designer and customize the fields each participant fills in.

04.title: 表單設計器：自訂報名欄位
04.next_title: 收費設定：費用、付款、折扣碼

narration.v1: 歡迎回到 RegMaster 教學。本部影片主題是『表單設計器』。報名表單蒐集到的資料，直接決定後續報到、分組、結算的順暢度。RegMaster 的表單設計器採用拖拉式介面：左側是欄位面板，中間是表單畫布，點選任何一個欄位，就能在設定區調整細節，全程不用寫程式。
narration.v2: 左側欄位面板分成兩區。上方『基本欄位』提供多種型別：單行文字適合姓名或單位，多行文字適合自我介紹，下拉選單和單選讓報名者多選一，複選可以勾選多個項目，另外還有日期、數字、以及上傳檔案。下方『內建欄位』是已經內建格式驗證的常用欄位，像中文姓名、Email、電話、性別、生日、學校、教育階段，拖進來就會自動套用檢查。
narration.v3: 要新增欄位，把元件從面板拖到畫布就完成，欄位順序也能再拖曳調整。點選一個欄位後，可以修改標題、加上提示文字幫報名者填對、切換『必填』開關；選項類的欄位還能逐一編輯選項內容。實務建議：容易填錯的欄位都加一句說明，必填只留真正需要的，表單越精簡完成率越高。設計好按右上角『儲存』，公開報名頁就即時套用。

04.outro: 本部影片到這裡。直接點下方按鈕,看下一部:『收費設定:費用、付款、折扣碼』。或進入 regmaster-pro.web.app 看完整教學系列。

narration_en.v1: Welcome back to the RegMaster tutorials. This episode is all about the form designer. The quality of the data your form collects directly determines how smoothly later stages, check-in, matching, and final results, will run, so it's worth taking the time to get right. When you open the form designer, you'll see RegMaster has already placed built-in fields for you, including name, email, phone, date of birth, and emergency contact. You don't need to rebuild these, just reorder them or switch off the ones you don't need. The beauty of built-in fields is that formatting, validation, and privacy handling are all done for you.
narration_en.v2: The left panel offers a variety of custom field components: single-line text, multi-line text, single choice, multiple choice, dropdown, file upload, plus date and time. Drag a component onto the form area to add it instantly. Each field has a 'required' toggle, and you can add hint text to help registrants fill it in correctly. We recommend adding a short note to any field that's easy to get wrong, which noticeably lowers your registration failure rate.
narration_en.v3: For events that need vetting, consider adding upload fields like 'team captain ID' or 'coach consent form.' For arts events, you might add 'portfolio link' and 'artist statement.' Once your form is ready, click 'Save' in the top-right, and the public page updates its fields instantly. The form writes directly into every registration record, ready for export, results, and scoring later. Get your registration form right, and the data you collect stays clean and usable. In the next episode, we'll turn to fees and set up pricing, payments, and discount codes all at once.

05.title: 收費設定:費用、付款、折扣碼
05.next_title: 退費政策、報名上限與三種錄取模式

narration.v1: 歡迎回到 RegMaster 教學。本部影片講『收費設定』，從費用項目、付款方式到折扣碼，三個區塊配合得好，營收結構就立得起來。回到活動設定，切到『收費』分頁。RegMaster 支援多項費用，例如報名費、保險費、餐點費，每一項都可以單獨命名、設金額，並決定是否必選。系統會在報名最後一步自動加總，不必手算。對於有早鳥、優惠、學生票的活動，可以建多個項目並用條件控制。
narration.v2: 付款方式區可以同時打開『銀行轉帳』與『PayUNI 線上付款』。銀行轉帳適合熟悉對帳的主辦方，PayUNI 則支援信用卡與超商代碼，報名者體驗最順。兩者也可以同時開放，由報名者自己選。如果是高金額活動，PayUNI 線上付款能大幅降低未繳費的流失。
narration.v3: 下方『折扣碼』區，可以建立早鳥碼、團報碼或推廣合作碼。每個碼可以設定折抵金額或折扣百分比，以及可使用次數上限。折扣碼非常適合分階段行銷，例如三月前用 EARLY200 折兩百元、四月團報碼 GROUP500 帶五人享優惠，效果立竿見影。收費架構打好，活動的營收基礎就穩了。下一部我們處理退費政策、上限與三種錄取模式，把營運邊界完整劃清楚。

05.outro: 本部影片到這裡。直接點下方按鈕,看下一部:『退費政策、報名上限與三種錄取模式』。或進入 regmaster-pro.web.app 看完整教學系列。

narration_en.v1: Welcome back to the RegMaster tutorials. This episode covers fee settings, from fee items and payment methods to discount codes. Get these three areas working together, and your revenue structure stands on solid ground. Back in event settings, switch to the 'Fees' tab. RegMaster supports multiple fee items, such as a registration fee, insurance fee, or meal fee, each of which you can name, price, and mark as required or optional. The system totals everything automatically at the final step of registration, so there's no manual math. For events with early-bird, promotional, or student pricing, you can create multiple items and control them with conditions.
narration_en.v2: In the payment methods area, you can enable both bank transfer and PayUNI online payment. Bank transfer suits organizers comfortable with reconciliation, while PayUNI supports credit cards and convenience-store codes for the smoothest registrant experience. You can also enable both and let registrants choose. For high-value events, PayUNI online payment greatly reduces drop-off from unpaid registrations.
narration_en.v3: In the 'Discount Codes' area below, you can create early-bird codes, group codes, or partner promo codes. Each code can be set to a fixed discount amount or a percentage, along with a usage limit. Discount codes are perfect for phased marketing, for example EARLY200 for 200 off before March, then a GROUP500 group code in April for parties of five. The results are immediate. With your fee structure in place, your event's revenue foundation is solid. In the next episode, we'll handle refund policies, caps, and the three acceptance modes, drawing your operational boundaries clearly.

06.title: 退費政策、報名上限與三種錄取模式
06.next_title: 開放報名與公開頁分享

narration.v1: 歡迎回到 RegMaster 教學。本部影片把『退費政策、報名上限、錄取模式』三件事一次講清楚，這些是常見糾紛來源，預先設定好能省下後續大量客服。退費政策區，建議直接套用 RegMaster 提供的標準範本，再依活動性質調整。常見規則是:活動前十天全額退、十天內七折退、三天內不退。寫清楚可以避免後續糾紛，公開頁也會自動顯示這段條款。退費條款是消保法的重點，把它寫好就少一半的客服爭議。
narration.v2: 報名上限提供總額上限、各組別上限、以及候補名單功能。打開候補後，達到上限時報名者可以排隊，前面有人取消會自動遞補並寄信通知，特別適合熱門賽事。候補機制讓你不必反覆手動調整名額，名額用滿到開賽的這段時間，系統會幫你顧好。
narration.v3: RegMaster 提供三種錄取模式:『先到先得』適合公開賽事;『主辦審核』適合需要審資格的競賽，所有報名先進待審清單;『自訂正取』則讓主辦完整掌控錄取名單，適合邀請賽或國家隊選拔。三選一後儲存，整個活動的營運邏輯就定案了。三大政策一旦定案，活動的營運邏輯就明確了。下一部我們會把活動推上線，正式開放報名。

06.outro: 本部影片到這裡。直接點下方按鈕,看下一部:『開放報名與公開頁分享』。或進入 regmaster-pro.web.app 看完整教學系列。

narration_en.v1: Welcome back to the RegMaster tutorials. This episode explains three things at once: refund policy, registration caps, and acceptance modes. These are common sources of disputes, and setting them up in advance saves you a lot of support work later. In the refund policy area, we recommend applying RegMaster's standard template directly, then adjusting it to fit your event. A common rule is: full refund up to ten days before the event, 70% within ten days, and no refund within three days. Spelling it out prevents disputes, and your public page displays the terms automatically. Refund terms are a key point under consumer protection law; get them right, and you'll cut customer-service disputes in half.
narration_en.v2: Registration caps offer a total cap, per-division caps, and a waitlist feature. With the waitlist on, registrants can queue once the cap is reached; when someone ahead cancels, the next person is promoted automatically and notified by email, perfect for popular events. The waitlist means you don't have to keep adjusting capacity by hand; from the moment you're full until the event begins, the system looks after it for you.
narration_en.v3: RegMaster offers three acceptance modes. First-come, first-served suits open events. Organizer review suits competitions that require vetting, where every registration goes into a pending-review list first. And Manual selection gives the organizer full control over the accepted list, ideal for invitationals or national-team trials. Pick one and save, and your event's operating logic is settled. With these three policies locked in, your operational logic is clear. In the next episode, we'll take the event live and officially open registration.

07.title: 開放報名與公開頁分享
07.next_title: 報名名單管理:CSV 匯入匯出

narration.v1: 歡迎回到 RegMaster 教學。本部影片走『開放報名與公開頁分享』，把先前所有設定推上線、面對真實報名者，這是活動的關鍵時刻。活動骨架、組別、表單、收費都設好之後，回到活動設定。開放報名前 RegMaster 會做一道把關:報名表單裡必須至少有一個必填的 Email 欄位，否則無法寄送確認信與通知;如果還沒設，系統會擋下並提示你先到『表單設計』補上。把這個前提準備好，活動就達到可以公開的最低標準。
narration.v2: 檢查通過後，按下『開放報名』，活動狀態立刻切換為『報名中』。系統會在活動工具區提供公開頁連結，你可以按『複製公開連結』取得分享網址，再貼到海報、官網或社群上宣傳，讓報名者一鍵直達報名頁。開放後，所有來自公開頁的報名都會即時進入後台。
narration.v3: 點『預覽公開頁』，可以從報名者視角檢查呈現結果:封面、簡介、組別、收費、報名按鈕全部到位。建議把這個連結傳給同事或合作夥伴試用一次，再做最後微調，正式開賣後就可以放心宣傳了。公開頁的所有資訊都來自前面設定，改回後台儲存後公開頁會即時同步。活動上線之後，真正的營運挑戰才剛開始。下一部我們進入報名名單管理，看看名單怎麼整、怎麼匯出匯入。

07.outro: 本部影片到這裡。直接點下方按鈕,看下一部:『報名名單管理:CSV 匯入匯出』。或進入 regmaster-pro.web.app 看完整教學系列。

narration_en.v1: Welcome back to the RegMaster tutorials. This episode covers opening registration and sharing your public page, pushing all your earlier settings live and facing real registrants. This is a pivotal moment for your event. Once the skeleton, divisions, form, and fees are all set, head back to event settings. Before opening registration, RegMaster runs one safeguard: your registration form must include at least one required email field, otherwise confirmation emails and notifications can't be sent. If you haven't added one, the system blocks you and prompts you to add it in the form designer first. With that in place, your event meets the minimum bar to go public.
narration_en.v2: Once the check passes, click 'Open Registration,' and the event status switches to 'Accepting Registrations' immediately. The system presents a public link alongside a QR code: the public link is your share URL, and the QR code can be printed on posters or flyers so people can scan straight to the registration page. After opening, every registration from the public page flows into your dashboard in real time.
narration_en.v3: Click 'Preview Public Page' to check how everything looks from the registrant's point of view: cover image, summary, divisions, fees, and the register button all in place. We recommend sending this link to a colleague or partner for a quick test run, then making final tweaks before you start promoting with confidence. Everything on the public page comes from your earlier settings, and it syncs instantly whenever you save changes in the dashboard. Once your event is live, the real operational challenge is just beginning. In the next episode, we'll move on to managing your registration list, how to organize it and import and export it.

08.title: 報名名單管理:搜尋、詳情與匯出
08.next_title: 確認付款與銀行轉帳對帳

narration.v1: 歡迎回到 RegMaster 教學。本部影片走「報名名單管理」，列表的查找與處理效率，決定主辦在尖峰時段的工作節奏。從活動中心進入「報名管理」，頁面分成兩個分頁:「報名統計」用圖表呈現報名趨勢與時段熱點，「報名列表」把每一筆報名以表格列出，欄位有編號、中文與英文隊名、狀態與付款狀態。上方的搜尋框支援以編號、隊名、狀態或付款狀態做模糊比對，幾秒鐘就能定位到某一筆報名。報名人數一多，這個列表的工作效率就直接決定整場活動的營運順暢度。
narration.v2: 點任一筆的「查看」進入詳情，可以檢視完整表單內容、上傳的附件檔案、報名時間，以及同意條款的簽署紀錄。具編輯權限的管理者能直接修正錯字或補資料;下方的「備註」欄則是內部筆記，只有主辦團隊看得到，方便交班與聯繫紀錄。每個欄位都有逐項稽核，事後可追溯誰在何時改了什麼。
narration.v3: 需要整批處理或備份時，點右上角「匯出所有報名資料」，系統會跳出視窗讓你選擇 CSV 或 Excel 格式;檔案帶有 UTF-8 編碼，中文在試算表裡不會變成亂碼。匯出後就能在試算表自由排序、篩選、製作名牌或核對名單。列表上的「退費申請」按鈕則集中顯示待處理的退費，方便快速切換。報名列表掌握度高，後續結算才會順。下一部，我們處理付款的確認與對帳。

08.outro: 本部影片到這裡。直接點下方按鈕,看下一部:『確認付款與銀行轉帳對帳』。或進入 regmaster-pro.web.app 看完整教學系列。

narration_en.v1: Welcome back to the RegMaster tutorials. This episode covers registration list management. How well you can search and process the list in bulk sets your working rhythm during peak periods. From the event hub, open 'Registration Management,' where all registration data appears as a list. The filters at the top let you quickly narrow by division, status, or payment situation, and the search box supports fuzzy matching by name, email, or phone, so you can pinpoint a registrant in seconds. As registration numbers grow, the efficiency of this list directly determines how smoothly your whole event runs.
narration_en.v2: Click any entry to open its detail page, where you can review the full form content, attachments, and registration history. 'Edit' in the top-right lets you fix typos or add information; the 'Notes' field below is for internal notes visible only to your team, handy for handovers and keeping a record of contact. Every edit is written to the activity log, so it's always traceable.
narration_en.v3: For bulk work, use 'Export CSV' to download the registration list, organize it in a spreadsheet, and import it back. You can also add registrations by uploading a CSV directly, and the system creates them automatically by matching the columns. A common case is importing students who paid offline, saving you manual entry. Before importing, we recommend downloading the template file to make sure column names and order line up. The better you know your registration list, the smoother your final results will be. In the next episode, we'll handle confirming payments and reconciliation.

09.title: 確認付款與銀行轉帳對帳

narration.v1: 歡迎回到 RegMaster 教學。本部影片講『確認付款與銀行轉帳對帳』，這是金流的命脈，搞錯一次就會影響後續所有作業，務必走熟。從活動中心進入『帳務』，預設顯示待付款清單，每筆會列出姓名與應付金額。當報名者用銀行或 ATM 轉帳繳費後，你在對帳工具輸入對方轉出帳號的後幾碼，系統就會把帳號對得上的報名自動標記為已付款，不必逐筆手動比對。這套機制讓沒有信用卡或不想線上付款的學員，也能用最簡單的方式繳費。
narration.v2: 從銀行對帳單複製到帳金額後，回到 RegMaster，比對最後對帳碼。對到了，就點該筆右側的『確認付款』，狀態立刻變成已付款，報名者也會收到確認信，整個對帳流程就完成了。對帳通常每天傍晚集中處理一次，效率最高，也不會打擾到正在報名的人。
narration.v3: 清單裡每一筆都看得到付款方式與付款狀態，待付款的會標成『待確認』，方便你一眼掌握進度。需要逐筆人工核對時，點該筆的『查看』可以打開完整報名詳情再做判斷，確認無誤就按『確認付款』，那一列就會轉為已付款。每一筆金流異動，系統都會記進左側的『操作紀錄』，事後要追查有憑有據。金流是主辦最在意的環節，這套對帳邏輯就是 RegMaster 累積多年實戰經驗的成果。對帳熟練之後，金流就不會再失控。下一部會處理退費申請，看看怎麼把退費流程也標準化。

09.outro: 本部影片到這裡。直接點下方按鈕,看下一部:『處理退費申請』。或進入 regmaster-pro.web.app 看完整教學系列。

narration_en.v1: Welcome back to the RegMaster tutorials. This episode covers confirming payments and bank-transfer reconciliation. This is the lifeblood of your cash flow; one mistake ripples through everything afterward, so it's worth mastering. From the event hub, open 'Payment Management,' which shows the pending-payment list by default, with each entry listing the name and amount due. When a registrant pays by bank or ATM transfer, you enter the last few digits of their transfer-out account into the reconciliation tool, and the system automatically marks any registration whose account matches as paid, with no need to compare entries one by one. This lets students who don't have a credit card, or prefer not to pay online, settle up in the simplest way.
narration_en.v2: After copying the received amount from your bank statement, return to RegMaster and check it against the reconciliation details. When it matches, click 'Confirm Payment' on the right of that entry; the status changes to paid instantly, the registrant receives a confirmation email, and the reconciliation is complete. Reconciliation is usually most efficient done once in the early evening, and it won't disturb anyone in the middle of registering.
narration_en.v3: If a payment isn't in the default list, use the search box at the top to find the matching registration by name or email. For occasional payments or combined transfers, just use 'Manually Mark as Paid' and fill in the amount and a note. Every change is written to the activity log for later review. Cash flow is what organizers care about most, and this reconciliation logic is the result of RegMaster's years of real-world experience. Once you're fluent with reconciliation, your cash flow stays under control. In the next episode, we'll handle refund requests and standardize that process too.

10.title: 處理退費申請
10.next_title: 平台代收轉付（PayUNI 撥款）

narration.v1: 歡迎回到 RegMaster 教學。本部影片處理『退費申請』，從接收申請到實際完成退款，每個步驟都串在同一個面板，操作邏輯極清楚。切到『退費申請』分頁，所有報名者提出的退費請求會集中在這裡。每筆都會顯示申請時間、原因說明，以及依退費政策自動計算的可退金額，避免主辦逐筆翻條款手算。系統把麻煩的條款判斷自動化，主辦只剩下『是否同意』這個業務決定，把心力放在判斷上。
narration.v2: 點開一筆查看詳情，確認原因合理後按『核准』，可以微調最終退費金額並填上內部備註。若不符政策，可按『駁回』並寫明理由，系統會自動寄信通知申請人，整個流程公開透明。寄信內容包含拒絕理由與退費條款連結，避免進一步爭議。
narration.v3: 核准後，請依照公司流程實際匯款給報名者，匯款完成後回到該筆退費單按下『標記已退費』，狀態即進入完成。同時系統會自動更新付款紀錄與會計報表，方便月結。如果你的活動使用 PayUNI 收款，這部分還能搭配下一部的代收轉付，連匯款都不必自己手動處理。退費流程閉環，主辦就能輕鬆很多。下一部我們進入代收轉付，看 PayUNI 怎麼把款項撥回主辦帳戶。

10.outro: 本部影片到這裡。直接點下方按鈕,看下一部:『平台代收轉付,PayUNI 撥款』。或進入 regmaster-pro.web.app 看完整教學系列。

narration_en.v1: Welcome back to the RegMaster tutorials. This episode handles refund requests. From receiving a request to actually completing the refund, every step lives in the same panel, with crystal-clear logic. Switch to the 'Refund Requests' tab, where all the requests submitted by registrants are gathered. Each shows the request time, the stated reason, and the refundable amount calculated automatically from your refund policy, so you don't have to flip through the terms and do the math yourself. The system automates the tricky policy judgment, leaving you with just one business decision: approve or not. You get to put your energy into judgment.
narration_en.v2: Click a request to view its details. Once you've confirmed the reason is reasonable, click 'Approve,' where you can fine-tune the final refund amount and add an internal note. If it doesn't meet the policy, click 'Reject' and state the reason; the system automatically emails the applicant, keeping the whole process open and transparent. The email includes the rejection reason and a link to the refund terms, heading off further disputes.
narration_en.v3: After approving, transfer the money to the registrant following your company's process. Once that's done, return to the refund request and click 'Mark as Refunded,' which moves the status to complete. At the same time, the system updates the payment record and accounting report, making month-end close easier. If your event collects payments through PayUNI, this pairs with the payout flow in the next episode, so you don't even have to transfer the money by hand. With the refund loop closed, an organizer's job gets a lot easier. In the next episode, we'll move into payouts and see how PayUNI returns funds to the organizer's account.

11.title: 平台代收轉付（PayUNI 撥款）
11.next_title: 群發通知與 Email 行銷活動

narration.v1: 歡迎回到 RegMaster 教學。這一部講『平台代收轉付』，把 PayUNI 線上收到的款項撥回主辦自己銀行帳戶的標準流程，月結時最關鍵。如果你的活動透過 PayUNI 線上付款收款，款項會先由平台代收。進入活動帳務頁的『平台代收轉付』分頁，最上方先確認兩件事：『收款帳戶』顯示平台要把錢匯進去的銀行帳號，這裡已經填好中國信託的帳戶；右邊『轉帳週期』則標示匯款頻率、下次平台匯款日，以及 PayUNI 手續費，數字一目了然。
narration.v2: 往下看『各報名收款明細』。實際營運時，每一筆線上付款都會列在這裡，標示報名隊伍、收款金額、扣除的手續費，以及你實際可領到的淨額；勾選想撥款的款項，系統會即時加總實領合計，再扣掉每批 NT$15 的匯費，算出真正會匯入的金額，最後按『申請匯款』送出。這個示範活動目前還沒有已完成的線上付款待撥，所以明細暫時是空的。這個流程把月底繁瑣的請款動作標準化，避免主辦自己對帳出錯。
narration.v3: 申請送出後，會出現在最下方的『我的匯款申請 / 紀錄』。每一筆都看得到申請編號、申請時間、實付金額、預計匯款日與目前狀態，從待審核、已核准到已匯款，進度清清楚楚，月結對帳時直接參照。代收轉付讓主辦不必自己面對信用卡風險與請款流程，平台幫你扛掉合規與資安的負擔。代收轉付走完，整條金流鏈就完整了。下一部我們轉到行銷與通知，看看怎麼經營你的會員。

11.outro: 本部影片到這裡。直接點下方按鈕,看下一部:『群發通知與 Email 行銷活動』。或進入 regmaster-pro.web.app 看完整教學系列。

narration_en.v1: Welcome back to the RegMaster tutorials. This episode covers platform-collected payouts, the standard process for returning the money PayUNI collects online back to the organizer's own bank account, crucial at month-end. If your event collects payments through PayUNI, the funds are first held by the platform. Open the 'Platform Payouts' tab on the event's billing page and confirm two things at the top: the 'Payout Account' shows the bank account the platform will remit to — already filled in here — and 'Transfer Cycle' shows the remittance frequency, the next payout date, and the PayUNI fee.
narration_en.v2: Below is the 'Per-Registration Collection Detail'. In live operation, every online payment is listed here with the team, the amount collected, the fee deducted, and the net you actually receive; tick the items you want to pay out and the system totals the net, deducts the NT$15 wire fee per batch, and shows the amount that will actually be remitted, then you click 'Request Payout'. This demo event has no completed online payments awaiting payout yet, so the list is currently empty. The flow standardizes the tedious month-end requesting work and prevents reconciliation mistakes.
narration_en.v3: Once submitted, the request appears at the bottom under 'My Payout Requests / Records'. Each one shows the request ID, request time, amount paid, expected deposit date, and current status — from pending to approved to remitted — so progress is crystal clear for month-end reconciliation. Collect-and-disburse means organizers never face credit-card risk or the requesting process themselves; the platform shoulders compliance and security. With payouts complete, your entire cash-flow chain is in place. Next, we shift to marketing and notifications.

12.title: 群發通知與 Email 行銷活動

narration.v1: 歡迎回到 RegMaster 教學。本部影片處理『群發通知與 Email 行銷』，把賽事通知與行銷活動分清楚，能讓你發信收信都更精準。進入『通知公告』，可以對特定活動發布公告。打開『同步寄送 Email』，公告會立即進到所有報名者信箱，也會顯示在公開頁與報名者的『我的報名』頁，三方同步避免訊息漏接。對於賽程異動、場地變更、雨備啟動這類重要通知，這個功能特別關鍵，能在十分鐘內把所有人通知到位。
narration.v2: 如果是行銷導購而不是賽事通知，請用『行銷活動』模組。可以選擇收件對象:所有舊報名者、特定活動報名者、或自訂條件。可以自訂主旨與內容，套用後即可發送。對於常辦活動的主辦，這個模組就是最便宜的會員行銷工具。
narration.v3: 設定排程寄送時間，系統會在指定時刻自動送出，不必守著電腦。Email 會套用 RegMaster 的標題列與頁尾，外觀專業一致。能寫、能排、能對指定對象群發，整套通知與行銷流程就齊全了。通知與行銷雙軌並進，回購與資訊傳遞都顧到。下一部我們走入活動當天，從 QR 報到開始。

narration_en.v1: Welcome back to the RegMaster tutorials. This episode handles broadcast notifications and email marketing. Keeping event notices and marketing campaigns clearly separated makes both your sending and your tracking more precise. Open 'Announcements,' where you can publish a notice for a specific event. Turn on 'Send by email,' and the notice goes straight to every registrant's inbox, and also appears on the public page and on each registrant's 'My Registrations' page, synced across all three so no message slips through. For important notices like schedule changes, venue changes, or rain plans, this feature is especially crucial, getting everyone informed within ten minutes.
narration_en.v2: If it's marketing rather than an event notice, use the 'Campaigns' module instead. You can choose your recipients: all past registrants, registrants of a specific event, or custom conditions. You can customize the subject and content, then send. For organizers who run events regularly, this module is the cheapest member-marketing tool there is.
narration_en.v3: Set a scheduled send time, and the system sends it automatically at the appointed moment, with no need to sit by your computer. The email applies RegMaster's header and footer for a consistent, professional look. Being able to write, schedule, and broadcast to a chosen audience completes the whole notification-and-marketing flow. With notifications and marketing running on parallel tracks, both repeat business and information delivery are covered. In the next episode, we step into event day, starting with QR check-in.

15.title: 即時排行榜與成績結算

narration.v1: 歡迎回到 RegMaster 教學。本部影片走『即時排行榜與成績結算』，從評分輸入到名次出爐，整段流程數位化、零失真。進入『評分系統』的『結果排名』分頁，會看到 ACM 風格的即時排行榜，依各隊得分自動排序。按一下『重新整理』就會載入最新送出的分數，把畫面投影到主舞台螢幕，營造現場氣氛，也讓選手與觀眾隨時看到目前進度，現場參與感大幅提升。
narration.v2: 排行榜的名次是依你設定的量表權重自動計算，去極值與正規化也都已內建，主辦不必自己手算總分。如果某筆分數有誤需要更正，評審或主辦修改後，重新整理排名就會即時反映，全程數位化、零失真。
narration.v3: 確認名次後，可以一鍵『匯出 CSV』或『匯出 Excel』作為成績冊。到下一部製作證書時，把對象範圍選『得獎者』，名單、組別、名次就會自動帶入版型，全程不必複製貼上。整個比賽從報名、評分到頒獎，資料一路串通，沒有手動轉檔的麻煩，也沒有人工輸入的誤差。成績一旦結算完成，下一步就是把榮譽傳遞給選手。下一部我們進入證書製作。

16.next_title: AI 助手:規則分析與智能問答

narration.v1: 歡迎回到 RegMaster 教學。本部影片處理『證書製作與發放』，比賽落幕的最後一里路，做得漂亮選手會記得很久。進入『證書製作』，選一款內建版型開始。每張版型都有預留欄位:姓名、組別、名次、活動名稱、日期，這些都是動態欄位，會在批次產生時自動帶入結算結果，不必逐張填寫。內建版型可以直接用，也可以複製後改成主辦單位的專屬版型。
narration.v2: 點『編輯版型』可以調整文字大小、位置、顏色，並上傳主辦單位的章戳與簽名圖。預覽區會即時顯示效果，確認排版美觀後儲存，整批證書就會套用這個風格。對需要法定授權字樣的版型，編輯器也支援多行段落與固定字串，方便符合各種規範。

17.title: AI 助手:規則分析與智能問答

narration.v1: 歡迎回到 RegMaster 教學。本部影片聚焦『AI 助手』，讓 AI 幫你檢視規則、回覆常見問題，把主辦從重複勞動裡解放出來。進入『AI 助手』，第一步把活動規則或競賽辦法 PDF 上傳到知識庫。之後 AI 回答問題時就會以這份文件為依據，等於把規則助理放進後台。對於從紙本沿用多年的辦法，先讓 AI 讀過，後續查詢與回覆都會更快。
